name: Roguelike
description: Short runs, procedural variety and builds that change every time, with progression between runs.

pillars.name: Run Structure
pillars.vision: How a run is built and paced.

pillars.name: Procedural Generation
pillars.vision: Generating floors, rooms and layouts that stay fair.

pillars.name: Encounters
pillars.vision: Fights, events and choices along the way.

pillars.name: Rewards
pillars.vision: What the player is offered during a run, and when.

pillars.name: Build Variety
pillars.vision: What makes each run play differently.

pillars.name: Items
pillars.vision: Items and relics and their effects.

pillars.name: Synergies
pillars.vision: How items and upgrades combine into builds.

pillars.name: Upgrades
pillars.vision: In-run upgrades to stats and abilities.

pillars.name: Meta Progression
pillars.vision: Unlocks and progress that carry over between runs.

pillars.name: Content Pools
pillars.vision: The enemies, rooms and events the generator draws from, and how they're weighted.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.vision: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
